body:
## Summary

`deleteSessionById` (src/chat/panel.ts:650-675) deletes the session file, then delegates to `switchSession(lastSession.id)` — but `currentSession` still points at the deleted session, and `switchSession` unconditionally saves it before switching (panel.ts:597-600 → `saveSession(currentSession)` in src/chat/sessions.ts). The "deleted" conversation is re-written to `<workspace>/.bos/sessions/<old-id>.json`.

The store list (saved later) excludes it, so the file is invisible in the UI but persists on disk with full content — an orphan that `migrateOldHistory` never cleans.

## Repro

1. Delete the active session via `/session delete`.
2. `<workspace>/.bos/sessions/<old-id>.json` still exists with full content.

## Fix

In `deleteSessionById`, set `currentSession = null` before calling `switchSession` (switchSession already guards `if (currentSession)`), or skip the save in `switchSession` when the id matches the one being deleted.
title: Deleting the active session resurrects the deleted session file on disk (data loss/orphan)
